_purpose: Test vectors for scripts/score/gate-harness.mjs. These exercise the gate semantics of the Bayesian Role Scorer (Ch.11): liveness and timeline are MULTIPLIERS, not addends.
_provenance: SYNTHETIC. Every company name, title, and probability below is a hand-constructed test vector, not a record. No number here is a claim about any real company, posting, or person. Expected values are derived by hand from the scorer's own documented formula (composite = Σ vote·weight × liveness × timeline) using the CONFIG defaults in role-scorer.mjs (sponsorship 0.35, fit 0.30, role_quality 0.0, apply_threshold 0.30, consider_floor 0.20, gate_zero 0.05).

_config_assumed.note: If role-scorer.mjs CONFIG changes, these expected values go stale. The harness asserts the observed config matches this block and reports CONFIG DRIFT if it does not.

cases.tests: A closed liveness gate zeroes the composite even when every vote is maximal.

expect.why: voteSum 0.65 × (0.0 × 1.0) = 0. liveness 0.0 <= gate_zero 0.05 so the closed-gate branch fires.

cases.tests: A closed timeline gate zeroes the composite even when every vote is maximal.
A gate exactly AT gate_zero (0.05) is treated as closed — the comparison is <=, not <.

expect.why: voteSum 0.65 × 0.05 = 0.0325. liveness 0.05 <= 0.05 so the gate is closed and the reason must say gated, not merely low-score.

cases.tests: A gate JUST above gate_zero is open — the resulting Skip must be a low-score Skip, not a gated Skip. Distinguishes the two Skip paths.

expect.why: voteSum 0.65 × 0.06 = 0.039. 0.06 > 0.05 so no gate closes; composite 0.039 < consider_floor 0.20 so this is a low-score Skip. The reason must NOT claim it was gated.

cases.tests: Two partial gates compose multiplicatively (0.5 x 0.5 = 0.25), not additively. This is the single most direct gate-as-vote discriminator.

expect.why: voteSum 0.65 × (0.5 × 0.5 = 0.25) = 0.1625, below consider_floor 0.20. If gates were additive votes this would score ABOVE apply_threshold and flip to Apply — which is exactly the bug this case exists to catch.

cases.tests: Positive control: with open gates and strong votes the scorer must reach Apply. Proves the harness is not simply asserting everything is Skip.

expect.why: voteSum = 0.9·0.35 + 0.8·0.30 = 0.555; gates 1.0 × 1.0. 0.555 >= 0.30, tier proven is not a soft tier, timeline 1.0 is not < 0.6, so Apply.

cases.tests: A timeline below 0.6 is a soft spot: it demotes an above-threshold role from Apply to Consider without closing the gate.

expect.why: voteSum 0.555 × 0.55 = 0.30525 -> rounded 0.3053, still >= 0.30. timeline 0.55 < 0.6 triggers the soft-timeline demotion to Consider.

cases.tests: An override with a decision but no documented reason must NOT change the recommendation, and must raise a warning.

expect.why: voteSum = 0.1·0.35 + 0.1·0.30 = 0.065 -> Skip. The override supplies a decision with no reason, so Ch.11 says ignore it: recommendation stays Skip and a warning is attached.

cases.tests: Paired with G9b to measure whether the Ch.9 role-quality signal reaches the composite at all.
Identical to G9a except role_quality p goes from 0.0 to 1.0. If the composite does not move, the Ch.9 signal is inert at the current weight.

expect.why: voteSum = 0.5·0.35 + 0.5·0.30 + 1.0·0.0 = 0.325 — identical to G9a because role_quality carries weight 0.0. Expected given CONFIG, and reported as a structural finding, not a failure.

paired_checks.means: role_quality p moved 0.0 -> 1.0 with no change to the composite. This is expected while weights.role_quality = 0.0, and is the open authorial decision recorded in DOMAIN.md gap 3 — not a code defect. Reported so it cannot be forgotten.
